inputs.name: HubRemoteController.constructor.remote
inputs.description: Optional HubRemoteRuntime providing the relay origin and management adapter for matched actions. Defaults to undefined; explicit null or omission disables a matched action by throwing an Error with code `remote-disabled`.

inputs.name: HubRemoteController.handle.request
inputs.description: An incoming HTTP Request whose pathname and method select POST `/api/remote/hosts`, GET or DELETE `/api/remote/hosts/{hostId}`, or DELETE `/api/remote/hosts/{hostId}/devices/{deviceId}`. Paths are matched literally with no extra or empty segments; registration alone reads an `application/json` object body of at most 20,000 bytes.

inputs.name: HubRemoteController.handle.actor
inputs.description: The verified session actor supplied after upstream authentication; its `id` is copied into the owner passed to the relay. No owner is taken from the request, and the controller reads no other actor property.

outputs.name: HubRemoteController.handle
outputs.description: Resolves to the HTTP Response for the route result: unmatched paths return 404, recognized paths with unsupported methods return 405, and registration returns 201. Other successful relay results use the hub JSON response with status 200.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error with code `invalid-input` is thrown for a missing or non-JSON registration body, invalid or non-object JSON, a body over 20,000 bytes, registration fields or host/device identifiers that fail validation, or a relay 400 refusal carrying that code.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error with code `remote-disabled` is thrown when a matched action has no configured runtime because the constructor received null or undefined.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error with code `forbidden` is thrown when the relay refuses a management request with status 403 and error code `forbidden`.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error with code `not-found` is thrown when the relay refuses a management request with status 404 and error code `not-found`.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error with code `unavailable` is thrown when relay access fails, its JSON reply cannot be parsed, its refusal is not a defined status/code pair, or its successful reply fails shape validation.
